seo.title: Kura Card
seo.description: Spend your balance anywhere Visa is accepted. 0.5% cashback on eligible spend and 0% foreign exchange fees — the card was planned but never launched, and the waitlist is closed.
seo.keywords: Kura Card, debit card, spend globally, cashback, financial account

hero.title: Kura Card
hero.description: Use your balance like a modern financial account — anywhere Visa is accepted. 0.5% cashback on eligible spend and 0% foreign exchange fees.

status.label: Discontinued
status.title: The Kura Card never launched
status.description: Kura ran a waitlist and evaluated card partners, but no card was ever issued. The waitlist is closed and no cards will be issued. This page is kept as a record of what was planned.

benefits.label: Card benefits
benefits.title: What the Kura Card was planned to offer

items.title: Spend from your balance
items.description: Use the money in your Kura account in the real world — online, in-store, and abroad. Your funds stay under your control.

items.title: Visa, everywhere
items.description: A modern debit card accepted wherever Visa is — with 0.5% cashback on eligible spend and 0% foreign exchange fees.

items.title: Simple setup
items.description: Connect your account, verify your identity, and get your card — designed to take minutes, not days.

items.title: Instant controls
items.description: Freeze and unfreeze your card from the app with one tap. Full control when you need it.

items.title: Flexible top-ups
items.description: Add funds by bank transfer, card deposit, or from your Kura account balance — however works best for you.

items.title: Clear transaction history
items.description: Every purchase, refund, and authorization in one place. Know exactly where your money goes.

how.title: How it works
how.description: Getting your Kura Card is designed to be simple. Your account stays connected to your card — one experience, end to end.
steps: Start spending with your virtual card
how.note: Regional availability will be confirmed at launch. Card and payment services are provided through regulated partners.

seo.title: TrackFi
seo.description: Your complete financial picture in one dashboard. Connect banks, investments, and accounts — protected with zero access encryption.
seo.keywords: TrackFi, portfolio, net worth, financial dashboard, privacy, account tracking

hero.title: See everything in one place
hero.description: Your complete financial picture — banking, investments, and accounts — in one beautiful dashboard. Private by default, encrypted by design.

overview.label: Overview
overview.title: One dashboard for all your money

pillars.title: Banking
pillars.subtitle: Checking, savings, and credit
pillars.description: Link bank accounts and credit cards with read-only access. View balances, track spending, and understand your cash flow — encrypted before it ever leaves your device.

pillars.title: Investments
pillars.subtitle: Stocks, ETFs, and exchange accounts
pillars.description: Connect brokerage and investment accounts alongside major exchange platforms. See your full investment picture in one place.

pillars.title: Digital assets
pillars.subtitle: Portfolio and account positions
pillars.description: Track digital asset holdings across supported networks. Connect external accounts or link your Kura account with one tap.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.description: Your assets and identity remain under your control. TrackFi is built so your data stays yours.

security.title: Zero access encryption
security.description: Your financial data is encrypted on your device before sync. Kura stores ciphertext only — we cannot read your records.

security.title: Passkey protection
security.description: Unlock your dashboard with Face ID or Touch ID. Your encryption key never leaves your device unprotected.

security.title: Unified dashboard
security.description: Banking, investments, and digital holdings in one calm screen — without switching apps.

security.title: Always up to date
security.description: Scheduled background sync keeps connected accounts current while your session is active.

plans.title: Free to start, Pro for more
plans.description: Kura Basic includes TrackFi with unlimited account connections and 30 days of encrypted history. Upgrade for deeper history, priority sync, and advanced insights.
